command: docker exec -w /opt/gemp-swccg/src swccg-official-app-1 mvn -o -q -pl gemp-swccg-server -am test -Dtest=NativeProofOpeningOracleTests -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false

scope: Eight-card hands, 51 Reserve and zero activated Force per side
Blasters deployed by both sides; Dark carrier movement preserves attachment
Imperial Barrier paid using carried Force, expires after Light turn
Defensive Imperial Blaster hit, zero numeric battle losses, mandatory forfeit and continued turn
